protocol.hypothesis: Fixed prior-only 90-day role-level calibration of all four unchanged sleeve evaluators. A shadow proposal book supplies labels even for withheld signals; publication eligibility never sees an unfinished result. No parameter sweep or discarded failed static result.
protocol.rules: Every15m close; existing native-source/geometry/qualification/arbitration. Independently simulated per-role shadow books have one active signal per symbol and no artificial three-symbol research-label cap. A single combined publication simulation retains three active symbols maximum, one per asset, opposing setup abstention and observed-close release. Labels enter calibration only after their exit candle CLOSE; rolling-window boundary uses known-close time. No stage-end forced profits. Validation carries prior development labels but resets the combined book at the declared boundary.
